# ErgonUI
React components built on shadcn/ui component source and community work, including copied/adapted MIT-licensed components alongside original ErgonUI components.

- Kanban: /r/kanban.json — Give every card a clear place to move forward.
- Calendar+: /r/calendar-plus.json — A complete schedule, with room for every event.
- Gantt Chart: /r/gantt-chart.json — See how tasks, milestones, and dependencies come together.
- Rich Text Editor: /r/rich-text-editor.json — Give stories shape, with images right where they belong.
- Button: /r/button.json — A small surface for your next big action.
- Float Button: /r/float-button.json — Keep useful actions within easy reach.
- Icon: /r/icon.json — A consistent visual language, down to the pixel.
- Typography: /r/typography.json — Give every word the right hierarchy.
- Divider: /r/divider.json — A little breathing room between ideas.
- Flex: /r/flex.json — Align, distribute, and wrap with intention.
- Grid: /r/grid.json — Responsive structure for any screen.
- Layout: /r/layout.json — The foundation of a well-composed application.
- Layout+: /r/layout-plus.json — An application shell, ready for real work.
- Masonry: /r/masonry.json — Let content find its natural rhythm.
- Space: /r/space.json — Consistent spacing, without the guesswork.
- Splitter: /r/splitter.json — A workspace that adapts to the way you work.
- Anchor: /r/anchor.json — Find your place in a long conversation.
- Breadcrumb: /r/breadcrumb.json — A clear path back to where you started.
- Dropdown: /r/dropdown.json — The right options, right when you need them.
- Menu: /r/menu.json — Make every destination easy to discover.
- Pagination: /r/pagination.json — Big collections, manageable chapters.
- Steps: /r/steps.json — Turn a complex process into a clear path.
- Tabs: /r/tabs.json — Related views, one focused space.
- Auto Complete: /r/auto-complete.json — A helpful suggestion, a little less typing.

- Checkbox: /r/checkbox.json — One choice, or a few. You decide.
- Check Card+: /r/check-card-plus.json — Make choosing feel more considered.
- Color Picker: /r/color-picker.json — Find exactly the right shade.
- Date Picker: /r/date-picker.json — Make time for the dates that matter.
- Form: /r/form.json — Thoughtful forms, from first field to submit.

- Field+: /r/field-plus.json — One field. Many ways to read and edit.

- Input Number: /r/input-number.json — Precise values, effortless adjustments.
